verdict.rationale: LegalZoom explicitly offers access to '150+ customizable legal documents' for a year as part of its formation packages, which covers routine business documents like agreements and policies. However, community commentary (a lawyer user) cautions that while basic filings are a commodity, actual document content like operating agreements 'couldn't be more wrong' to assume as commodity, suggesting template quality/customization limits for more complex needs; other users note forms are 'easy enough to fill out yourself' without paid help, undercutting the value-add. Missing for 10: explicit breakdown of NDA/policy-specific templates, evidence of attorney-vetting process behind each template, and independent quality assessment of document library beyond LLC-related bundle mentions.
